title: AN ELITE CRAWLER ON YOU BITES HARDER BUT SLOWER
why: A balance fix found by the review of the crawler latch (his order: a crawler that catches you keeps biting until it is killed). Elite crawlers bite 1.6 times harder, and with the latch nothing shakes them off, so one elite hanging on downed a full-health player with no armour in 2.8 seconds whether he stood, sprinted or rolled; a normal crawler takes 4.9. Before the latch only a man standing still got that rate. Now an elite that hangs on keeps its harder bite but bites 1.6 times less often, so it downs that same player in about 4.5 seconds, and its 2.2 times the health is still what makes it the dangerous one: it stays on you longer while you kill it. A normal crawler is unchanged. DEMO and CAREER the same.
now: An elite crawler hanging on to you bites harder but less often, so it no longer downs you in under 3 seconds.

edits.anchor: if(e.cd<=0){ LATCH_BITE=1; try{ netHitPlayer(_lb,e.dmg*(e.elite?(CFG.eliteDmg===undefined?1.6:CFG.eliteDmg):1),'crawler',e.name,e.x,e.y); } finally{ LATCH_BITE=0; } e.cd=.7; }
